kind: Independent supported-block original-load and saved-geometry audit
scope: A limited-depth native tabletop running-thread trial. Original force aggregation and saved-pose geometry remain separate. No material calibration or policy-training robustness certificate.

archived_model_identity.method: Exact hash-verified archived XML; current scene generator is not used

controller_identity.inspection_method: Static exact function blocks and archived helper sources; controller code is not executed

original_load_history.method: Immutable original arrays; independent aggregation and original sampled contact-frame transform only; no force reconstruction or dynamics
original_load_history.timing: mj_step contact forces and contact geometry are from the pre-integration state at recorded time minus timestep; saved qpos/qvel are the post-integration state

saved_geometry.method: Saved post-integration qpos only; native kinematics/collision candidates, zero dynamics integration or force solve
saved_geometry.scope: Candidates do not prove native loads. Original mj_step derived geometry precedes these integrated poses by one step.

passive_workpiece_properties.method: Compile exact recorded scene only; zero integration, commands or force solve
passive_workpiece_properties.scope: Zero free-joint passive terms excludes inherited joint drag/stiction or extra rotational inertia as the source of open-reset stability. Physical thread/finger contact friction remains enabled; this does not qualify contact-law accuracy.

archived_model_identity.method: Exact hash-verified archived XML; current scene generator is not used

passive_self_locking_during_open_reset.scope: All-substep maximum yaw/axial drift only after declared formed-flank engagement; starting-cone resets are reported separately

right_bolt_grasp_retention.scope: Within each original bilateral loaded closed grasp; references end on intentional opening and are acquired again after real regrasp

native_unexpected_collision_clearance.scope: Every native solved substep; intended table/block, pads/workpieces, thread and pre-pickup bolt-rest contacts are declared separately

all_substep_left_pad_contact_retention.scope: Every physics substep at and after the end of settle_left_block; no lift or physical roll is commanded

settled_table_load_window.scope: No-bolt settled stabilization: original native table force bears block weight; contact candidates alone do not establish support

table_bears_block_weight_before_bolt_pic.scope: Pre-bolt no-lift stabilization: >=90% mean block weight on table, <=10% mean positive hand upward load, >=99% loaded table duty over >=100 ms

all_substep_table_load_retention.scope: Every original native substep after stabilization acquisition; brief gaps remain failures

final_window.scope: No-bolt settled stabilization: original native table force bears block weight; contact candidates alone do not establish support

table_bears_weight_throughout_active_tas.scope: Every active trailing original-force window, including pickup/entry/turn/reset/regrasp; same90%table/10%positive-hand-up/99%duty thresholds as stabilization, without hiding transient load sharing

native_cone_entry_acquired_before_rotati.scope: Settled native lead-in load only; does not qualify formed-flank capture

native_starting_support_before_searching.scope: Every searching release/open reset must have measured settled native thread-pair support; pre-release acquisition timeout retains closed jaws

original_metadata_export_note: Original bytes and failed gates remain unchanged; named unexecuted legacy minima are exported as null only in this strict JSON derivative
